page.$description: Default page background: a warm off-white.

card.$description: Cards, panels, inputs and modals that sit on the page.

sunken.$description: Recessed areas: table headers, footers, disabled inputs.

brand.$description: Brand-blue bands and hero blocks. Put text.on-brand on it.

accent.$description: Soft gold highlight behind callouts and donation prompts. Text on it: text.primary or gold.700.

paper.$description: The page's own off-white. Every section on a page with a plain header, and self-contained blocks (cards, contact panel, CTA) everywhere.

white.$description: Open sections on a landing page (hero header), alternating with paper from the first section after the hero. Edged with border.subtle top and bottom because white is only 1.06:1 against paper. Default text colors (text.primary 17:1, text.link 7.5:1).

blue.$description: Emphasis band, kept for a future block it suits (e.g. impact numbers), at most once per page; no block uses it yet. Text switches to text.on-brand (7.5:1), text.on-brand-secondary (5.9:1) and text.link-on-brand (7.5:1, underlined); focus ring brand.gold (4.3:1).

primary.$description: Default text and headings on light surfaces (16:1 on surface.page).

heading.$description: Section and card headings, list markers (7.5:1 on white). On section.blue it becomes text.on-brand.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: descriptions, metadata, captions (6.3:1 on surface.page).

subtle.$description: Placeholders, timestamps, helper text (4.8:1 on surface.page). The lightest gray allowed for text.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on surface.brand or blue.700 (7.5:1 on brand blue).

on-brand-secondary.$description: Supporting text on surface.brand and section.blue: intros, roles, captions (5.9:1).

link-on-brand.$description: Links on section.blue (7.5:1). Always underlined, since body text there is white too. text.link is brand blue and would vanish.

on-accent.$description: Text on brand-gold fills, such as the gold Donate button (8.2:1).

link.$description: Links in running text; underline them. Hover: blue.700.

subtle.$description: Dividers and card outlines (decorative, not for control edges).

strong.$description: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and other controls; meets 3:1 against white.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline: 2px with a 2px offset (4.0:1 on white, 3.8:1 on the page). On brand-blue backgrounds use brand.gold; on gold buttons over blue use neutral.0.

success.$description: Success text, icons and borders (5.3:1 on white). Pair with an icon or word.

success-bg.$description: Success message background; success text on it is 4.7:1.

warning.$description: Warning text, icons and borders (5.9:1 on white). Gold itself is too light for warning text.

warning-bg.$description: Warning message background; warning text on it is 5.4:1.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive actions, required-field marks (6.5:1 on white).

danger-bg.$description: Error message background; danger text on it is 5.6:1.

info-bg.$description: Info message background; info text on it is 6.8:1.
